objectives.label: Ask to register
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you'd like to register with the reflexive 'Rad bi se vpisal ___.'

objectives.label: Answer the ID request
objectives.descriptorEN: Say whether you have your ID — 'Ja, izvolite.' or 'Ne, nimam ...'.

objectives.label: Explain you don't have it
objectives.descriptorEN: Handle the negative 'nimam ga pri sebi' (negation + genitive).

objectives.label: Take in the instruction
objectives.descriptorEN: Understand the conditional 'come back with a document' (receptive).

n1.speaker: npc
n1.sl: Lep pozdrav! Vam lahko kako pomagam?
n1.en: Warm greetings! Can I help you with anything?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Lep pozdrav! Vam lahko kako pomagam?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi se vpisal v knjižnico.
c1a.en: Hello. I'd like to register at the library.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi člansko izkaznico.
c1b.en: Hello. I'd like a membership card.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Ali imate s sabo osebni dokument?
n2.en: Do you have an ID document with you?
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Ali imate s sabo osebni dokument?

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.en: No, I don't have it on me.

n3a.speaker: npc
n3a.sl: Odlično. Tukaj je vaša izkaznica. Dobrodošli!
n3a.en: Excellent. Here is your card. Welcome!
n3a.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Odlično. Tukaj je vaša izkaznica. Dobrodošli!

n3b.speaker: npc
n3b.sl: Brez dokumenta vas ne morem vpisati. Prosim, vrnite se z dokumentom.
n3b.en: Without a document I can't register you. Please come back with it.
n3b.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Brez dokumenta vas ne morem vpisati. Prosim, vrnite se z dokumentom.
